regime_context: The detector shows a broad, fractured regime (one_narrative=false, rotation.breadth view 'narrowing', absorption 0.30) with no single dominant theme and 'Memory, HBM & Storage' atop the raw momentum rank but flagged eligible:false (failing the absolute-trend gate). The only validated leg (gate_helps=true) is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate, so eligible, trend-healthy, high-breadth defensives/healthcare/software names are the reliable risk-control anchors, while the raw leader is a broken-trend display item. Track record shows directional accuracy below coin-flip (0.444), so most convictions default low.
emerging_watch: Watch whether 'Non-AI Software' (IGV) deepens its leadership handoff: it is the headline narrative, crowded, trend-tagged, and the rotation challenger to Memory/HBM. The observable condition is a persistent IGV relative-strength gain versus SMH for 10 consecutive sessions with one_narrative still false — this would retire the watch and flag a genuine confirmed software-over-semis handoff.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the cleanest alignment of the detector's validated risk-control leg: eligible=true, trend tag, high durability_bar (0.80, best among top-10 eligible names), strong breadth (0.889) and quiet val_state. It is crowded (z=1.24) but crowding is a size-down caution only, not a reason to hold underweight. The call is stay-with-the-trend for vol-controlled exposure, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: PPH is crowded and heavily rate-sensitive healthcare; a sharp rise in long yields or a single adverse policy headline on drug pricing could compress the entire group despite breadth.

falsifier.text: PPH closes below its 50-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Managed Care has the single highest durability_bar among all eligible names (0.88) plus trend tag and breadth 0.889, marking it as the most trend-cohesive eligible defensive. The crowded flag (z=1.22) is a cap-not-fade caution. Directional lean is low-conviction continuation given the detector's no-forecast contract.
theses.dissent: The theme shares XLV with a crowded healthcare aggregate; if a single dominant narrative re-emerges (one_narrative flips true), non-dominant defensives routinely lag whatever coherent leadership forms.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks below its 200-day moving average before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Despite the strongest raw momentum score (2.175), the theme fails the absolute-trend gate (eligible:false) with a very low durability_bar (0.24) and zero breadth (0.0) — a broken-trend, low-cohesion leadership display. Given the validated edge is trend-gate discipline, avoiding the ineligible raw leader is the risk-consistent stance, framed as exclusion not a short/fade.
theses.dissent: Memory/HBM can rip violently on a single supply-chain or capex headline, which a low-durability gate cannot catch; excluding it may cost upside if the raw momentum re-validates into a durable trend.

falsifier.text: SMH's 20-day rolling trend re-validates (eligibility flips true) before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
